bio: Yolanda Huang is currently studying psychology and neuroscience at the University of Toronto. You can spot her having meaningful conversations with patients at a hospital, marketing for UofT clubs, coaching and choreographing routines for artistic swimmers, or café hopping to find the best matcha spot in Downtown TO. Not one café left unconquered. After publishing a business psychology paper in high school, she spent the summer of her first year interning in a bioinformatics lab at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, learning wet-lab experiments like western blot and dry-lab skills like DEG analysis. If you really get to know her, she's great at losing her phone then realizing she was holding it in her hand the whole time. Send help.
name: Yuheng (Yolanda) Huang
program: Bachelor of Science (Honours) · University of Toronto
